PatchNotes.mysteryGiftLiveAtPokeMonWorldsXp: Mystery Gift live at Pokémon Worlds / XP!
PatchNotes.comingToSanFranciscoForPokemonWorldsXpCo: Coming to San Francisco for Pokemon Worlds / XP? Come find the first-of-its-kind mystery gift distribution for Switch FireRed/LeafGreen! Receive a rare egg that unlocks a LEGENDARY experience!
PatchNotes.makeSureYouUnlockMysteryGiftFirstGoToAny: Make sure you unlock Mystery Gift first. Go to any PokeMart and interact with the questionnaire on the counter and put in: LINK TOGETHER WITH ALL
PatchNotes.noteThisIsAFanMadeProjectIMTaking: NOTE: This is a fan-made project. I'm taking huge care to test and make sure it is as proper and bug-free as possible. But as with all non-official methods, there is always a small chance for unintended behavior, so use at your own risk.
PatchNotes.discoverThisFanMadeMysteryGiftAtPokemonW: Discover this fan-made Mystery Gift at Pokemon Worlds in SF
PatchNotes.weHaveAWorkingPrototypeOfMysteryEventFor: We have a working prototype of Mystery Event for an unmodded Switch or Switch 2 FireRed / LeafGreen game. Come to Pokémon Worlds / XP in San Francisco to get an exclusive look!
PatchNotes.thisWasAchievedByBuildingOffOfPart1Torna: This was achieved by building off of <part1>tornadus's FRLG LDN trade project</part1>. By extending this project to support hosting trades and wireless adapter interactions, we can now send custom mystery gift events to stock, unmodded Switch 1 and Switch 2 FireRed / LeafGreen games with a simple Linux and Wi-Fi USB adapter!
PatchNotes.moreDetailsWillComeUpAsTheTeamWorksOn: More details will come up as the team works on streamlining it so it is easy for anyone to try!
PatchNotes.mysteryEventOnSwitchFireredLeafgreenProt: Mystery Event on Switch FireRed / LeafGreen — prototype demo
PatchNotes.forThoseLookingToRibbonMasterTheirCheris: For those looking to ribbon master their cherished Pokémon before Pokemon Bank closes down, I created a tool to help look up battle and contest info to make it as accessible as possible. There is also a full set of guides for all ribbons, resources for figuring out which games Pokemon can go to, and a tool to create a single HOME screenshot.
